tpms.when: 2018 with the Tire Pressure Monitor reset in iDrive (the manual gives this reset for tires with special approval)
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the label in the driver's door opening.
On the iDrive screen, open My Vehicle, then Vehicle status, then Tire Pressure Monitor.
Switch the car to drive-ready (engine on) but stay parked.
Drive off. The wheels show gray and the screen says the Tire Pressure Monitor is resetting. It finishes on its own after several minutes of driving.
When the wheels turn green and the screen says the Tire Pressure Monitor is active, the reset is done.
tpms.note: If your tires are listed in the car's tire settings menu, the manual says to check the pressures and update the tire settings so they match the tires fitted. Gray wheels that stay gray can mean a system fault; have it checked. If the tire pressure light flashes for about a minute when you start the car and then stays on, the warning system itself has a fault. A reset won't fix it; have it checked.

notes: Only the 2018 owner's manual was checked for this model. The 2018 manual describes the service (Condition Based Service) display but gives no driver reset for the oil service, so no oil steps are listed here.
